features.description: 500 spins condensed into a reveal of the best three results.

review:
A dark, high-contrast Día de los Muertos story about two souls reuniting, on a cluster grid with an on-reel Coin Respin.

The standout is Reel Deal, which squeezes 500 spins into a reveal of the three best results. You can add one of five extra features, like a candle Booster or Chance x5, and a Rebuy button repeats your last purchase. Very high volatility, 10,000x max and 97% RTP. Free spins about once every 300 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 300 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
